scope: All 28 AQA separate-science required practicals, including both approaches to reaction rates and ecological sampling, plus the Organisation potometer method.

new_artwork.subject: Physics
new_artwork.purpose: Ammeter in series; voltmeter across the selected wire length between fixed and movable contacts. A ruler measures that length.

new_artwork.subject: Physics
new_artwork.purpose: Series and parallel resistor circuits, each with an ammeter measuring total current and a voltmeter across the whole combination.

new_artwork.subject: Physics
new_artwork.purpose: Low-voltage supply, variable resistor, ammeter and test component in series; voltmeter across the component.

new_artwork.subject: Physics
new_artwork.purpose: An insulated metal block contains a heater and temperature probe. A meter records electrical energy supplied.

new_artwork.subject: Physics
new_artwork.purpose: Identical lidded beakers have equal water masses, probes and equal thicknesses of different insulation.

new_artwork.subject: Physics
new_artwork.purpose: The water level rises from V₁ to V₂ when an irregular solid is fully submerged. Its volume is the difference.

new_artwork.subject: Physics
new_artwork.purpose: Unloaded and loaded spring lengths are read against a ruler with an eye-level pointer. Extension is their difference.

new_artwork.subject: Physics
new_artwork.purpose: A trolley carrying masses is pulled by a string over a pulley to a hanging mass. Light gates measure its motion.

new_artwork.subject: Physics
new_artwork.purpose: A ripple tank plan shows six crests spanning five wavelengths. A vibrating string shows adjacent nodes separated by half a wavelength.

new_artwork.subject: Physics
new_artwork.purpose: Incident and reflected rays meet at a mirror. A separate parallel-sided block bends light towards the normal on entry and away on exit.

new_artwork.subject: Physics
new_artwork.purpose: A detector compares emission from Leslie cube faces. Separately, an infrared lamp heats matched black and shiny samples.

new_artwork.subject: Chemistry
new_artwork.purpose: Filter excess insoluble solid, collect the salt solution, then concentrate it in an evaporating basin over a water bath and cool to crystallise.

new_artwork.subject: Chemistry
new_artwork.purpose: A supported insulated cup has a loose lid, thermometer bulb in the liquid and a stirrer.

new_artwork.subject: Chemistry
new_artwork.file: Chemistry - AQA/06 - Rate and extent of chemical change/Diagrams/disappearing-cross-practical.svg
new_artwork.purpose: Viewed from above, a cross under the flask becomes hidden as sulfur makes the liquid cloudy. Keep the viewing depth constant.

new_artwork.subject: Chemistry
new_artwork.purpose: Paper hangs in a covered vessel. The pencil baseline and sample spots are above the solvent; the solvent front is marked higher up the paper.

new_artwork.subject: Chemistry
new_artwork.purpose: A clean wire loop holds a sample in the blue non-luminous flame of a Bunsen burner.

new_artwork.subject: Biology
new_artwork.purpose: A coverslip is lowered at an angle onto a thin stained specimen on a glass slide, using a mounted needle.

new_artwork.subject: Biology
new_artwork.purpose: Equal-sized antimicrobial discs sit on an inoculated agar plate. Clear zones differ in diameter; a solvent-only control has no clear zone.

new_artwork.subject: Biology
new_artwork.purpose: Equal-sized potato cylinders are immersed in equal volumes of different concentrations, then blotted and reweighed.

new_artwork.subject: Biology
new_artwork.purpose: Positive food-test results: reducing sugar gives a coloured Benedict’s precipitate after warming, starch blue-black iodine, protein purple Biuret and lipid a Sudan-stained oil layer.

new_artwork.subject: Biology
new_artwork.purpose: Starch, amylase and buffer react in a controlled water bath. Fresh samples go into separate iodine wells every thirty seconds until starch is no longer detected.

new_artwork.subject: Biology
new_artwork.purpose: A leafy shoot is sealed into water-filled tubing. An air bubble moves along a capillary towards the shoot, and a reservoir allows it to be reset.

new_artwork.subject: Biology
new_artwork.purpose: The ruler starts with zero level with the participant’s open thumb and finger. Record fall distance when caught and convert it to reaction time.

new_artwork.subject: Biology
new_artwork.purpose: Comparable seedlings receive one-sided or all-round light. The shoot bends towards one-sided light; record lengths and labelled drawings.

new_artwork.subject: Biology
new_artwork.purpose: Quadrats placed at regular distances along a transect sample an environmental gradient. Record abundance and the environmental factor at each site.

new_artwork.subject: Biology
new_artwork.purpose: Milk, sodium carbonate and indicator equilibrate in a controlled water bath before lipase is added. Measure time to the same pH endpoint.
